title: World's Finest Comics #266 DC 1981 Dollar Comic Superman Batman Lady Lunar
conditionDescription: Bright cover with spine wear and a small crease near the top left; page edges toned and worn at the top right; back cover toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
World's Finest Comics #266 (January 1981), DC Comics - Dollar Comic, no ads, 5 features: Superman and Batman vs. Lady Lunar, plus Green Arrow, Hawkman, Red Tornado and Shazam! First issue with the Daily Planet news page. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Daily Planet news page (September 1980).

Condition: bright cover with spine wear and a small crease near the top left; page edges toned and worn at the top right; back cover toned (see close-up photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
